segments.source: Onyx positions Monarch as the darker, more developed counterpart to Geometry. Its current page lists Colombia and Ethiopia and describes rotating microlots, which means the year-round name cannot stand in for a permanent farm or variety record. The page says mixed varieties. It also presents broad process fields alongside narrative wording that does not cleanly establish one process for every component; this review does not compress that into a false single-process claim. Check the current bag or ask Onyx for lot details.

segments.source: The product exists in multiple sizes, including a 2 oz sample and 10 oz retail bag. The sample is useful if the goal is to test the flavor direction with low waste; it is not enough for extensive grinder dialing. The 10 oz bag is the practical first review-sized purchase for most espresso drinkers.

segments.source: At 10 oz, a bag contains roughly sixteen 18 g doses before dialing waste. Store a working bag closed, cool and dry; general Stumptown guidance cautions against repeatedly moving an opened bag between freezer and room temperature.
